$comment: Every value this package exports, claimed once: as a block (plain name + what it is for), as part of one ("with"), or as internal. Read by scripts/catalogue.mjs; pnpm check:catalogue fails when this file and the package disagree.

blocks.name: Print plates
blocks.for: The Bambu Lab plate sizes (A1 and P/X series, A1 mini, H series) and the customer's chosen plate, remembered across apps.

blocks.name: Plate picker
blocks.for: The printer/plate picker on the stage, wired to the shared choice in one call.

blocks.name: Plate packing
blocks.for: Lay several parts out on a plate, and say how many plates it takes and what will not fit.

blocks.name: Build plate model
blocks.for: The 3D model of the chosen plate that sits under the part in the viewer.
